messages:
Nina R.: Heads-up: tail latency spike on 4-shard tensor-parallel jobs after yesterday's kernel-selector + batching heuristic change. Repro on stage. Trace attached below.

Nina R.: ```
run: batch=8, seq=2048, shards=4
p99 latency: baseline 420ms -> now 570ms (+35%)
quick note: allreduce wait time up, stream idle time increased
```

Ollie: Which kernel-selector commit was rolled? A/B or full rollout? @perf-bot any flamegraphs? :thinking_face:

perf-bot: Profile uploaded: https://perf.redwood/stage/run/97531 (nvprof + Nsight timeline)

Sam: Skimming the timeline: GPU-2 shows repeated host-syncs during graph replay. Seeing spikes at `cudaEventSynchronize` around the allreduce windows.

Anya: We also changed batching heuristic to prefer larger micro-batches for better kernel reuse. That can push the selector toward a different fused kernel that has less comm overlap.

Nina R.: KV prefetch was enabled on this run. Hypothesis: KV prefetch uses a separate stream that sometimes gets captured into CUDA graphs, causing implicit sync with the allreduce stream. Repro command: `./repro.sh --capture-kv`

Kevin: If capture pulls the KV stream into the graph, it can serialize with the compute stream. Can you share which kernels were chosen (fused vs unfused allreduce paths)? Also get an Nsight timeline.

Ollie: I can bisect the kernel-selector change. Short-term mitigation: revert batching heuristic in canary to see delta. Who will own the canary?

Anya: I'll flip the heuristic in a canary config and run 3 reps on stage. @ci-bot please trigger the canary job and run smoke tests.

ci-bot: Queued job 97533 (stage/canary). Will post results when finished. :white_check_mark:

Sam: Note: allreduce is NCCL ring across 4 GPUs. Trace shows rank-0 waiting on rank-1 ~30ms longer vs baseline. Looks like reduced comm/compute overlap not a pure kernel perf regression.

Nina R.: Plan: (1) canary revert batching heuristic (Anya) (2) run variant with KV prefetch but NO CUDA-graph capture (Ollie) (3) collect Nsight timeline + `nvprof --csv` counters (Sam). Post results here.

Kevin: SG. If capture is confirmed, options: disable capture for prefetch, attach prefetch buffers with host-to-device streams that aren't captured, or add `cudaStreamBeginCapture`/`EndCapture` scopes with explicit stream ordering. If kernel selector still picks worse kernel, we may need fallback logic.

Nina R.: Thanks all — I'll drop the baseline flame and the post-canary flame once jobs complete. Keep quick notes here, no need for long threads.
